**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
Initialize the brain session after two parallel agents (UI, memory), unblock PR #877 (promotion of the #863 drafts), then rule and ship #862 (the memory lane) through the SDD circuit.

## Instructions
- Push/PR/brain:review are Tier 2: ask first. Merge and promotion sittings are the maintainer's acts; never performed by the agent.
- Never stage `.memory/index.jsonl`/`manifest.json` hydration on a feature branch; restore them to HEAD before `memory:save` so the committed index diff is exactly +1.
- Conventional commits with `(#N)`, no Co-Authored-By (commit-msg hook refuses).
- Doctrine drafts go under `openspec/changes/<change>/brain-drafts/`; new-ADR drafts are named `adr-NNNN-slug.md` (no `.draft.md`).
- Committing after an APPROVE moves the approved head; corrections need a fresh round.

## Discoveries
- AGENTS.md is compiled from 5 SOURCE_DOCS via `compileAgentsMd` (brain/scripts/harness/backends/antigravity.mjs); a node one-liner regenerates it, no need for the full bootstrap.
- The cold reviewer's `rev` field stays at 1 across rounds (seen on #877 ×6 and #891 ×2) — a counter bug worth a look under #880.
- `memory:save` shape: `npm run memory:save -- "<title>" "<content>" --type <t> --issue N`.
- `brain:review` refuses without a PR number; run it after the PR exists, after ≥9 checks registered and none pending.
- apply-progress.md is an untracked operational artifact (#863 did not track it either).
- The previous memory agent left `fix-877-rev5.mjs` unexecuted at the worktree root; its premises held and applying it cleared cold-1..4.

## Accomplished
- PR #877 (Closes #876): rev-5 fix committed (240492cb), APPROVE, merged by the maintainer as f8bdca52. #876 closed.
- #862 ruled: L1–L9 as recommended + C1 (secret scrub required lane check) + C2 (deterministic collector dedup). Engram `sdd/issue-862-memory-lane/ruling`.
- SDD phases spec (sonnet), design (opus), tasks (sonnet), apply (sonnet) delegated; artifacts in openspec/changes/issue-862-memory-lane/ and engram topic keys spec/design/tasks/apply-progress.
- Four drafts: ADR-0034, ADR-0002 Amendment 2, consolidation-protocol §5, openspec README rule 3 patch note.
- Tickets filed: #886 (2.5 mrAutoMerge), #887 (3.1a collector), #888 (3.1b push+PR), #889 (3.1c path restriction/lane class/lane-scrub), #890 (3.1d retirement); maintainer approved them. Follow-up promotion sitting filed as #892. Comment on #864 with the dependency order.
- PR #891 (Closes #862, type:docs) opened; record-first via memory:save --issue 862; cold review APPROVE at 3fe0fde3 with two citation corrections, fixed in 7c46401b, second round APPROVE clean. 9 gates green. Ready for the maintainer's merge.

## Next Steps
- Maintainer: merge #891; approve #892 and run the promotion sitting (new ADR first, then ADR-0002 A2 and consolidation §5 via brain:promote, README rule 3 by hand).
- After merge: sdd-verify / sdd-archive for issue-862-memory-lane (tick tasks 5.1–5.3).
- Wave 3 slices in order: #886 → #887 → #888 → #889 → #890, with #805 before enabling auto-merge and #874 before #890.
- Brain UI epic #878: #879 (read model + brain:snapshot --json) has no dependency; #880 waits on the lane (#889) and the `review` type promotion.
- Worktrees for merged slices (876, 851, 863, 864, 870, 820) still present; clean when asked.

## Relevant Files
- openspec/changes/issue-862-memory-lane/{explore,proposal,spec,design,tasks,apply-progress}.md, brain-drafts/* — the ruling and its drafts
- openspec/changes/issue-864-memory-2-0/tasks.md — epic tasks with #886–#890 and the 2.4 REQ-3 note
- brain/core/methodology/harness-contract.md, memory-backend-contract.md, brain/project/decisions/adr-0002-*.md, AGENTS.md — #877 rev-5 fixes
- brain/scripts/harness/backends/antigravity.mjs — compileAgentsMd
- brain/scripts/memory/cli.mjs — memory:save
